data.title: 诗怀雅 · 日程本
data.description: 她把临时改动记进日程本，合上之前又确认了一遍晚餐的时间。
data.camera: 中近景，日程本与笔清晰
data.promptProse: Seated at a polished mahogany executive desk overlooking Lungmen's towering cityscape, Swire reviews appointments in an embossed leather-bound planner using a solid gold fountain pen. A crystal paperweight and leather blotter gleam under warm afternoon window light.
data.animaCaption: With a decisive flick of her gold pen, she confirms an evening schedule entry, looking up from her leather planner with sharp confidence.
